top_violation_types.title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The immunization record for one child was not up to date.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records Accessible - to Licensing (26 TAC §747.601(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child did not have any records on file.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During an investigation, it was determined an infant was placed in a play yard in another room unsupervised and sustained minor injuries.

top_violation_types.title: Notification of Changing Location or Address (26 TAC §747.301(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The provider did not notify Licensing/CCR of change of temporary address due to plumbing problems in the home.

top_violation_types.title: Permit holder responsibilities - Registered Homes (26 TAC §747.117(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder was not aware of minimum standards and will need additional training.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The admission forms used were outdated. The admission forms do not capture the required minimum standards changes of March 2023.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5405)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The current gas leak inspection was not available.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: RE-CITE: Staff needs to update the expired first aid and CPR training. Expired on April 2020.
